title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 5, section 116 (Fry Creek Recreation Area)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 5 No Shooting Areas (Section 6)
Fry Creek Recreation Area
116 That portion of the Province of British Columbia in M.U. 4-19 that is contained within the following described boundaries: Commencing at a point on the midline of Fry Creek approximately 6 kilometres upstream from the point of intersection of the midline of Fry Creek and the natural boundary of Kootenay Lake on the easterly shore thereof; thence in a general northeasterly direction upstream along the midline of Fry Creek to a point approximately 500 m upstream of the easterly edge of the slide area and including all intervening territory on either side of Fry Creek within the Fry Creek Canyon Recreation Area boundaries. [en. B.C. Reg. 204/91, s. 12.]
